# Cold-agent bar (v030-15) — the founder's answers, 2026-11-18

Given by the founder by dialog in the overseer session, answered by 2026-11-18 07:55Z, and relayed by the
overseer. The forks are the builder's `forks-founder.md` of the phase run `2026-11-18T06-33-34-phase` (F1–F5).
Each answer is his chosen label, verbatim, beside the fork's own option letter. F2 was not asked in this dialog.

## F1 — the wrong-call bar
The question said 0.2.0's run read 66 calls, 0 wrong, $0.82 under his bar «не больше 5 %», that 0.3.0's prompt is
wider than the one that baseline was measured on, that the run would make about 80 to 100 calls and meet new
refusals (`covered` on a closed select's option and under an open list, `malformed` on a `layout` without an id).

The four options: keep 5 % · 0 wrong · tighter than 5 % but above 0 (2 %) · 5 % with the engine's own limits not
counted.

His answer: «Оставить 5 % (Recommended)»

The fork's option A: at most 5 % wrong, the same rule as 0.2.0.

## F3 — the word to run a live fresh agent
The question: may `bash scripts/cold-agent.sh run stand` fire once, through his own Claude Code login, reaching
the model provider; 0.2.0 cost $0.82 at 66 calls under a $3 cap; never in CI or a loop.

The three options: once under the $3 cap · once under a higher cap ($5) · not now.

His answer: «Один раз, лимит $3 (Recommended)»

The fork's option A: one run, once, `--max-budget-usd 3`. It is his word for ONE run. By his F5 answer below, that
run fires only after the served error page exists.

## F4 — graph and actions answers reaching the model provider (a boundary widening)
The question named what would newly cross: in `graph`, stable ids, owner ids, component names, state names,
handler event names, flags; in `actions`, ids, the verb table's words, closed cause words; no control value and no
typed text by construction; the stand's apps only, from the public repository.

The three options: ratify graph and actions · actions only · neither.

His answer: «Утвердить graph и actions (Recommended)»

The fork's option A: the crossing is ratified for `graph` and `actions` answers on the live run; the security row
is restated at the wrap with this word.

## F5 — a served error page, so a cold agent meets `caused`
The question said that on the built binary no ordinary step on the six served apps answers `caused` (v030-10),
that the stand's code holds no log site, `panic!` or `Err(`, and that `caused` is proven today on fixture pages
alone, so a cold agent never meets it; and asked whether a seventh stand app whose buttons panic, return an error
and log should be added.

The three options, as read to him:
- in 0.4.0 (marked recommended): a route entry for the next version, 0.3.0's run names `caused` out of its reach;
- in 0.3.0, before the run: «Новый чанк (или перепланирование этого): седьмое приложение, его проверки на стенде,
  цель в подсказке и счётчик в вердикте. Холодный агент встречает ошибку и должен в ней разобраться. Цена: это
  расширение границы (новое отдаваемое приложение и авторский текст ошибок, уходящий провайдеру), живой прогон и
  закрытие 0.3.0 сдвигаются минимум на чанк.»
- not at all.

His answer: «В 0.3.0, до прогона»

He chose against the marked recommendation. The fork's option B. What the chosen option's own text states, and so
what his word covers: a new chunk or this one re-planned; a seventh served app; its stand checks; a goal in the
prompt; a count in the verdict; and the boundary widening it names — a new served app, and authored error text
crossing to the model provider in the run. The live run and the close of 0.3.0 move behind it.

## F2 — what the run's result may claim (asked in a second dialog, answered by 2026-11-18 08:59Z)
The question: what the README and the capability page say after the live run, on a pass and on a fail; 0.2.0's
README form was quoted beside it; no test pins the run's numbers.

The three options: the run as measured, naming its reach · the outcome and the counts alone · nothing until a
second run repeats it.

His answer: «Измеренное, с досягаемостью (Recommended)»

The fork's option A. As the option read to him: on a pass, the tools (fifteen), the apps, the call and wrong
counts, the bar, and that `graph`, `actions`, `layout`, the list and (by his F5) the error were each used, plus
what the run did not reach and where each is proven (handler coverage, a component alone, the seed, the fonts);
on a fail, the same counts, the reasons, and the heading «built, its cold-agent run failed against the bar» until
a run passes.

## The README's interim heading (the overseer's PROVISIONAL answer of 2026-11-18 04:24Z)
The question quoted the heading «0.3.0 — built, its cold-agent run to come» and the sentence «16 of its 17
capabilities are verified headlessly; a fresh agent's run over the new capabilities is the version's last step»,
said both are pushed (`764b4ba6`), and that by his F5 the heading stands longer than one chunk.

His answer: «Оставить (Recommended)»

The PROVISIONAL mark is discharged by this word: the wording is his.

This overseer's reading, not his words: how the page is built (which controls, what text, one app or a task of an
existing one) is technical and the builder's plan; whether to re-plan the pending chunk or add an entry ahead of
it is a route question settled at the route-resolve; the operator's earlier technical answer «`caused` named out
of the run's reach» is withdrawn by this answer.
